notes:
BUILD 31
- Settings (sensitivity, volumes, field of view, fullscreen) are saved to ferro.cfg next to the game and survive closing and updating.
- Volume is split: SOUND EFFECTS and MUSIC have their own sliders.
- Survivors: lightly armed loners wander the island (weaker than scientists, single shots, poor loot). Peaceful ones stand inside the Outpost; press E on one to trade.
- A red sight with a countdown shows in the top right while the Outpost turrets are locked on to you.
- Items that shared an icon now look different: heavy helmet, heavy jacket, plate suit, thermal goggles, tracking headset, large backpack, work and combat boots.
- Explosive 5.56 is a normal round with two black painted stripes.
- The sea is much quieter and only heard near the shore.
- Eoka no longer needs gunpowder to craft.
